claim.quote: The successful construction and operation of this prototype confirm the effectiveness of the right-side-up design, which will be used in future dark matter searches such as PICO-40L and PICO-500.

name: A buffer-free concept bubble chamber for PICO dark matter searches
notes: Filed under PICO-40L and PICO-500 because the paper presents the prototype as the proof of the design both use; the chamber itself ran at Drexel University, not at SNOLAB.

summary.plain: A buffer-free test chamber at Drexel University worked well enough to confirm the right-side-up design that PICO-40L and PICO-500 use. It is a prototype, not a dark matter search.
summary.technical: Drexel Bubble Chamber, the PICO collaboration's first C3F8 buffer-free prototype: runs at and below the nuclear-recoil thresholds used for WIMP searches, down to 1.19 keV; sensitivity to 137Cs gammas and 244Cm spontaneous-fission neutrons; acoustic alpha discrimination possible but few alphas observed (JINST 14, P08019). It is a prototype at Drexel University, not PICO-40L itself.

title: A buffer-free concept bubble chamber for PICO dark matter searches
why_it_matters: The abstract says the prototype confirms the right-side-up design to be used in PICO-40L and PICO-500.
